# Draft:Persian Awards

----
Persian Awards
Persian Awards is a cultural initiative based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. The organization hosts events and awards ceremonies intended to recognize Iranian-Canadian individuals and groups for contributions in cultural, artistic, social, and community activities. The initiative has been mentioned in several event listings and online announcements related to Iranian cultural activities in the Toronto area.
Activities
Activities associated with Persian Awards have included public cultural events in Toronto such as the Persian Most Influential Figures Awards and Man and Woman of the Year 2025, which took place in Toronto and featured award presentations and cultural performances. The Persian Film Awards 2026, including its official closing ceremony, was scheduled to be held in Toronto in March 2026.
Reception and coverage
Persian Awards has been referenced in online event directories and community listings. As of 2026, coverage in major independent news media is limited, and the organization’s activities are primarily documented through community-based sources and announcements.

Persian Awards
Persian Awards is a cultural initiative associated with presenting awards related to Iranian social, cultural, artistic, scientific, and civic activities.
History
According to its official website, Persian Awards was established in 2006. The initiative is described as focusing on cultural and social themes related to Iranian communities and activities.
Since 2024, the organizers have held an in-person award ceremony in Toronto, Canada. The event has been listed as part of an annual cultural festival program covering Iranian-related activities.
